Subject: Revised Delivery Date: 14 April

I'm writing to update you on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for the platform took longer to certify than anticipated, and as a result the delivery has moved by two weeks. The new delivery date is 14 April.

Our team has used the additional time to run the certification checks thoroughly and confirm that the integration meets the required standards before it goes live. We are continuing to work in parallel on the remaining components so that this extra time does not affect the overall quality of the final delivery.

We want to keep you fully informed as we move toward the new date, and we would welcome a short call this week to walk through the revised plan. Does 14 April still work well for your internal launch planning?
